# CBK AI

> CBK AI (ChatBotKit) is a platform for building intelligent AI agents that can understand, reason, and take action. Designed for developers building agentic AI with Node.js, serverless environments, and modern JavaScript frameworks.

CBK AI provides a comprehensive suite of tools and SDKs for building sophisticated agentic AI systems. The platform focuses on developer experience with clean APIs, comprehensive documentation, and support for all major AI models and deployment environments including AWS Lambda, Vercel Edge, and Cloudflare Workers.

Key features include:
- Multi-model support with unified interface
- Function calling and tool integration
- Real-time streaming completions
- Lightweight SDK design
- Serverless-optimized architecture
- CBK Relay for standardized AI API access

## Getting Started

- [Sign In](https://console.cbk.ai): No-code agent builder interface
- [Developer Docs](https://docs.cbk.ai): Complete SDK documentation and API references
- [SDK Overview](https://docs.cbk.ai/sdks): Core SDK installation and setup

## Core SDKs

- [@chatbotkit/sdk](https://docs.cbk.ai/sdks/@chatbotkit/sdk): Core API SDK for Node.js and serverless
- [@chatbotkit/agent](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatbotkit/agent): Agent SDK for building autonomous agents
- [@chatbotkit/react](https://docs.cbk.ai/sdks/@chatbotkit/react): React hooks and components
- [@chatbotkit/next](https://docs.cbk.ai/sdks/@chatbotkit/next): Next.js server and client utilities
- [@chatbotkit/fetch](https://docs.cbk.ai/sdks/@chatbotkit/fetch): Isomorphic fetch implementation

## SDKs for Other Languages and Tooling

- [Go SDK](https://github.com/chatbotkit/go-sdk): Official SDK for Go applications and services (`github.com/chatbotkit/go-sdk`)
- [Python SDK](https://pypi.org/project/chatbotkit/): Official async Python SDK (`pip install chatbotkit`)
- [Terraform Provider](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/chatbotkit/chatbotkit): Provision and manage ChatBotKit resources as infrastructure-as-code
- [CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@chatbotkit/cli): Manage agents and platform resources from the command line

## Optional

- [GitHub](https://github.com/chatbotkit/node-sdk): SDK source code and examples
- [Community](https://go.cbk.ai/discord): Join the developer community
